name: Australia
alert: Below IEA 90-day mandatory threshold. Refinery closures ongoing.
notes: Australia has closed most domestic refineries. Fully import-dependent. Ideal Dangote supply target.

name: New Zealand
alert: Last domestic refinery converted to import terminal in 2022.
notes: Zero domestic refining capacity. 100% import dependent. Dangote supply is a direct route.

name: Ireland
alert: No domestic production. Last refinery closed decades ago.
notes: Imports all petroleum products. Tight logistics. Strong Dangote opportunity.

name: South Africa
alert: Refineries ageing. Sasol & BP closures. Fuel shortages in inland areas.
notes: Closest African market to Dangote. Fuel crisis ongoing. Ideal supply deal candidate.

name: India
alert: Demand growing faster than reserves. Seeking cost-effective alternatives.
notes: Huge and growing market. Dangote refined products competitive for India coastal cities.

name: Singapore
alert: No domestic production. Major trading hub sensitive to Middle East pricing.
notes: Singapore is a major bunkering hub. Dangote supply could undercut Middle East pricing.

name: Brazil
alert: Petrobras refinery cuts creating regional shortfalls in Northeast Brazil.
notes: Northeast Brazil under-supplied. Atlantic route from Dangote is competitive.

name: Italy
alert: Just below IEA 90-day target. Several refineries running below capacity.
notes: Mediterranean gateway. Dangote supply via sea route is competitive.

name: Switzerland
alert: Mandatory IEA stockpile. No domestic production.
notes: Well-managed reserves but entirely import dependent.

name: United Kingdom
alert: North Sea production in long decline. Several refineries closed.
notes: Refineries shrinking. Long-term opportunity as North Sea exhausts.

name: Netherlands
alert: Rotterdam hub under pressure. Groningen gas field shutting down.
notes: Rotterdam is Europe's largest port. Critical swing supplier.

name: Belgium
alert: Falling below 90-day IEA target. Dependent on Antwerp refining hub.
notes: Antwerp is critical European hub.

name: Denmark
alert: North Sea production declining rapidly. Net importer by 2027.
notes: Own North Sea production shrinking.

name: South Korea
alert: Fully import dependent. Diversifying supply sources.
notes: One of the world's largest refiners. Seeks competitive crude supply.

name: Japan
alert: High strategic reserves. Supply chain disruption risk from Middle East.
notes: Very large consumer. Well-stocked but vulnerable to shipping disruptions.

name: Germany
alert: Meets IEA threshold. Russian pipeline cut-off resolved.
notes: Well-diversified supply. Transitioning heavily to renewables.

name: France
alert: Strategic reserves strong. Refineries operational.
notes: Stable but cost-conscious.

name: Spain
alert: Meets IEA threshold. Diversified supply chain.
notes: Stable. Atlantic coast access makes Dangote supply logistically feasible.

name: Sweden
alert: Meets IEA 90-day threshold. Transitioning to EV infrastructure.
notes: Strong energy transition policy. Long-term demand declining.

name: United States
alert: Strategic Petroleum Reserve partially drawn down. Rebuilding underway.
notes: Major domestic producer. Limited Dangote opportunity.
